## 验证 / Verification

- [ ] `bun run check`
- [ ] `bun run build`
- [ ] `bun run format:rust:check`
- [ ] `bun run test:rust`
- [ ] 已列出真实验证平台 / Real tested platforms are listed
- [ ] 已列出未验证平台 / Untested platforms are listed

## 开源检查 / Open-source hygiene

- [ ] 没有敏感信息、本机路径或生成产物 / No secrets, personal paths, or generated artifacts
- [ ] 行为变化已同步更新中英文文档 / Behavior changes are documented in both languages
- [ ] 发布说明中英文一一对应（如适用）/ Release notes match one-to-one when applicable
